long_biography.plain_text:
Through a management-controlled investment company, Italian financier Dario Federico Segre became a significant shareholder in public and private businesses. The firm served entrepreneurs and mid-sized companies by combining direct investment with corporate advice. With Antonio Favrin, Segre built a major stake in Valentino Fashion Group. His company also backed Eidos Partners, an adviser focused on mergers, acquisitions and restructuring.

Away from boardrooms, Segre developed an equally sustained commitment to offshore sailing. He progressed from small boats to ocean passages, skippering Atlantic and Pacific crossings over successive seasons. He has also competed internationally through an Italian sailing club, combining long-distance cruising with organised racing.
long_biography.html:
Through a management-controlled investment company, Italian financier Dario Federico Segre became a significant shareholder in public and private businesses. The firm served entrepreneurs and mid-sized companies by combining direct investment with corporate advice. With Antonio Favrin, Segre built a major stake in Valentino Fashion Group. His company also backed Eidos Partners, an adviser focused on mergers, acquisitions and restructuring.

Away from boardrooms, Segre developed an equally sustained commitment to offshore sailing. He progressed from small boats to ocean passages, skippering Atlantic and Pacific crossings over successive seasons. He has also competed internationally through an Italian sailing club, combining long-distance cruising with organised racing.
